def launch(c,phase,config_sha,retained_audit=False):
    import array
    import socket
    import fcntl
    need(retained_audit in (False,True,'r2') and (not retained_audit or phase=='F'),'retained audit only supports phase F')
    group=Group(c,phase);v=c['limits'][phase];packet=Path(c['paths']['packet'])
    need((Path(c['paths']['execution_root'])/'ONE_SHOT_STARTED').is_file(),'one-shot start missing')
    supervisor_envelope(c);bound_identities(c);quotas(c,phase)
    prior_logs=('_precheck','','_audit','_retained_audit') if retained_audit=='r2' else ('_precheck','','_audit')
    start=time.monotonic();counts={k:sum((packet/f'F{s}.{k}').stat().st_size for s in prior_logs) for k in ('stdout','stderr')} if retained_audit else {'stdout':0,'stderr':0};records=[]
    for k,n in counts.items():need(n<=v[k+'_bytes'],'log cap hit '+phase+' '+k)

        group.prior_cpu=read_numbers(group.path.parent/'cpu.stat').get('usage_usec',0)
        if retained_audit=='r2':need(group.prior_cpu>=246681730,'phase CPU counter reset')
        need(group.prior_cpu<v['cpu_time_us'],'total cgroup CPU cap')
    try:
        group.create()
        variants=[(True,False)] if retained_audit else [(False,False)] if phase in ('B','E','F') else [(True,False)]
        if phase in ('E','F') and not retained_audit:variants=[(True,True),(False,False),(True,False)]  # same phase/group/deadline, data audit only
        for audit,precheck in variants:
            args=sandbox_args(c,phase,audit,precheck,retained_audit);suffix='_retained_audit_r2' if retained_audit=='r2' else '_retained_audit' if retained_audit else '_precheck' if precheck else '_audit' if audit and phase in ('E','F') else ''

def test_retained_f_audit_r2_binds_consumed_r411_artifacts_and_enforces_post_r411_bounds(self):
        _write(self.packet / 'F_retained_audit.stdout', b'')
        _write(
            self.packet / 'F_retained_audit.stderr',
            b'TERMINAL_REFUSAL: non-normalized dep-info path\n',
        )
        _write(
            self.packet / 'TERMINAL_FAILURE_RETAINED_AUDIT.json',
            runner.json_bytes(
                {
                    'message': 'phase exit nonzero F',
                    'native_outputs_accepted': False,
                    'type': 'Refusal',
                }
            ),
        )
        _write(
            self.packet
            / 'USED_LAUNCH_93645c50dfc6c31930def6df095941fec5f41243bede003b450fe0c3db0cf5f3',
            b'consumed\n',
        )
        self.c['total_wall_seconds'] = 6586
        self.c['limits']['F']['wall_seconds'] = 2566

        with patch.object(runner, 'owned_paths'):
            args = runner.sandbox_args(
                self.c, 'F', worker=True, precheck=False, retained_audit='r2'
            )
            self.assertIn('--retained-f-audit-r2', args)
            self.assertNotIn('--retained-f-audit', args)
            t_idx = args.index(str(self.target))
            self.assertEqual(args[t_idx - 1], '--ro-bind')

        preds = runner.prior_receipts(self.c, 'F', False, retained_audit='r2')
        self.assertEqual(set(preds), set(self.PREDECESSORS) | set(runner.R411_CONSUMED_PINS))

        runner.worker(self.c, 'F', retained_audit='r2')
        self.assertTrue((self.packet / 'F_RETAINED_QUARANTINED_OUTPUTS_R2.json').is_file())
        (self.packet / 'F_RETAINED_QUARANTINED_OUTPUTS_R2.json').unlink()

        # Cumulative F stderr (10237 + 47 + 47 = 10331) > 10300 refuses before create
        self.c['limits']['F']['stderr_bytes'] = 10300
        with (
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
            patch.object(runner, 'bound_identities'),
            patch.object(runner, 'quotas'),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
                runner.launch(self.c, 'F', self.config_sha, retained_audit='r2')
            self.assertIn('log cap hit F stderr', str(ctx.exception))
        self.c['limits']['F']['stderr_bytes'] = 16777216

        # Reset phases/cpu.stat (< 246681730) refuses
        with (
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
            patch.object(runner, 'bound_identities'),
            patch.object(runner, 'quotas'),
            patch.object(runner, '_cg_text', return_value='usage_usec 240632042\n'),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
                runner.launch(self.c, 'F', self.config_sha, retained_audit='r2')
            self.assertIn('phase CPU counter reset', str(ctx.exception))

        # Unreduced wall ceiling (> 6586 / 2566) refuses
        self.c['limits']['F']['wall_seconds'] = 2582
        with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
            runner.retained_f_audit(self.c, self.config_sha, retained_audit='r2')
        self.assertIn('post-R411 wall ceiling', str(ctx.exception))
        self.c['limits']['F']['wall_seconds'] = 2566

        # Reset supervisor/cpu.stat (< 56990698) refuses
        with (
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'signal'),
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'setitimer'),
            patch.object(runner, '_cg_text', return_value='usage_usec 48374910\n'),
            patch.object(runner, 'consent'),
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal) as ctx:
                runner.retained_f_audit(self.c, self.config_sha, retained_audit='r2')
            self.assertIn('supervisor CPU counter reset', str(ctx.exception))

        # Success path on 'r2'
        timers = []
        rlimits = []

        def _fake_launch_r2(c, phase, sha, retained_audit=False):
            self.assertEqual(retained_audit, 'r2')
            _write(self.packet / 'F_RETAINED_QUARANTINED_OUTPUTS_R2.json', b'{"ok":true}\n')
            return {
                'phase': 'F',
                'processes': [{'argv': [], 'audit_worker': True, 'child_exit': 0}],
                'environment': {},
                'wall_seconds': 0.25,
                'log_bytes': {'stdout': 0, 'stderr': 10331},
            }

        clock = iter([100.0, 104.0, 104.5])
        with (
            patch.object(runner.time, 'monotonic', side_effect=lambda: next(clock)),
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'signal'),
            patch.object(runner.signal, 'setitimer', side_effect=lambda w, v: timers.append(v)),
            patch.object(runner.resource, 'setrlimit', side_effect=lambda r, v: rlimits.append(v)),
            patch.object(runner, '_cg_text', return_value='usage_usec 56990698\n'),
            patch.object(runner, 'consent'),
            patch.object(runner, 'supervisor_envelope'),
            patch.object(runner, 'bound_identities'),
            patch.object(runner, 'owned_paths'),
            patch.object(runner, 'quotas'),
            patch.object(runner, 'launch', side_effect=_fake_launch_r2),
        ):
            runner.retained_f_audit(self.c, self.config_sha, retained_audit='r2')

        self.assertEqual(timers[0], 2566)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(timers[1], 2566 - 4.0)
        self.assertEqual(timers[-1], 0)
        self.assertEqual(rlimits[0], (10800 - 57, 10800 - 57))

        res = runner.jload(self.packet / 'F_RETAINED_AUDIT_R2_RESULT.json')
        self.assertEqual(res['retained_audit'], 'r2')
        self.assertIs(res['native_outputs_accepted'], False)
        self.assertEqual(set(res['predecessors']), set(self.PREDECESSORS) | set(runner.R411_CONSUMED_PINS))
